instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) for React components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Maintain strict dark theme as default (#0A0A0C background, #121318 cards, #C6FF00 primary accent).
Never use transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim on headers, dropdowns, or floating bars.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, chat elements, shot chart zones, timer buttons, and tabs for automated test validation.
Ensure all interactive components have explicit hover, active, and focus styles matching contrast guidelines.
Implement full mobile responsiveness with bottom navigation on phone viewports and persistent sidebar on desktop viewports.
Use Lucide icons or Phosphor icons, avoid AI assistant emojis (e.g., 🤖, 🧠, 🎯).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic Vercel/Stripe gray designs. Use athletic tactical typography, tight borders, high-contrast neons, and clear data hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous spacing (p-4 to p-8) and keep card containers separated with gap-6.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use explicit transitions such as 'transition-colors duration-200' or 'transition-transform duration-200'. Never use universal 'transition: all'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.text_alignment: Left-align body paragraphs and labels. Heading alignment can be centered in hero banners or share cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards. High contrast dark text (#0A0A0A) on Electric Lime buttons (#C6FF00).
